type.description: Filter by OpenAPI `tags` field. Matches one or more tags assigned to operations.

pattern.description: Tag name to match (case-sensitive). Can be a literal string or regex pattern.

type.description: Filter by OpenAPI `operationId` field. Each operation (GET, POST, etc.) has a unique identifier.

pattern.description: Operation ID to match (case-sensitive). Can be a literal string or regex pattern.

type.description: Filter by OpenAPI `path` (URL endpoint). Useful to group or filter by service segments like `/pets`, `/users`, etc.

pattern.description: URL path to match (case-sensitive). Can be a literal string or regex pattern. Matches against the full path.
HTTP method to match, as one of the `HttpMethod` values or a regex.

type.description: Filter by response or request content type: `'application/json'`, `'application/xml'`, etc.

pattern.description: Content type to match (case-sensitive). Can be a literal string or regex pattern.

type.description: Filter by schema component name (TypeScript or JSON schema). Matches schemas in `#/components/schemas`.

pattern.description: Schema name to match (case-sensitive). Can be a literal string or regex pattern.

items.description: Pattern filter that matches operations or schemas by tag, operationId, path, method, content type, or schema name.

description: Skips matching operations or schemas during generation.
